invariants.name: A text acts on a PR only when gh read that PR and HEAD holds its head
A text takes no PR only after the no-PR message with no --pr

abstraction.hides: The direct-file read sets of the mode router and delegates, the 24-principle index location, and the triage mode routing inside playbooks/babysit.md.
callersKnow: A delegate reads only mode SKILL.md and references/worker.md, capped at 2,000 source words with the four fixed rules in rule 1.
The router reads only SKILL.md with no argument and adds references/routes.md on a routed request.
Every PR text keeps the astack check pr-head head line and repair rule inside playbooks/babysit.md.
abstraction.deletionTest: Without worker.md and the folded mode router, every delegate loads 9 files totaling 7,190 words and repeats routes already on the rule card.

alternatives.name: Keep the 9-file delegate read set
alternatives.rejectedBecause: Every delegate run pays 7,190 words of upfront source text.

alternatives.name: Adopt the pstack worker card verbatim
alternatives.rejectedBecause: It drops the four fixed astack rules: owner gates, merge grant, ChangeProof and STE replies.

alternatives.name: Keep two copies of the principle index with a tie test
alternatives.rejectedBecause: Two copies add words and risk drift.

omitted: PrHeadCheck does not model source word counts or rule-home checks. The MR controls in tests/mode-router.test.ts, tests/supervision-text.test.ts and tests/skill-load-report.test.ts enforce those invariants.
Runtime behavioral equivalence between read sets is measured by the blind brief-set rubric in docs/runbooks/skill-load-measurement.md.

bounds: 3 gh answers, a named PR or none, 4 head relations and 3 runtime states, so each result of the command is reachable.
One check, one decision and at most one pull after a head stop.

negative.defect: A text that goes on after stop: HEAD does not hold PR_HEAD acts on a PR whose head HEAD does not hold.

limits: Source word counts do not measure host token counts or provider cache behavior.
Static text controls do not substitute for live brief-set trials under docs/runbooks/skill-load-measurement.md.
Exact-head CI, review, Shipping and every ordinary gate stay required.
